title: Unbeatable experience in Ronda and the white villages
text: The views driving through the countryside were beautiful and our guide explained about the agriculture and geography we were seeing. Ronda is a spectacular mountain city full of history, museums, gardens, restaurants and tapas bars. Our guide was the best yet, giving you time to take pictures and enjoy the city. He made this a truly special trip, focusing on the things we were most interested in seeing. title: Gorgeous Ronda
text: What a fabulous trip.  Our guide was so incredibly knowledgeable and so thoughtful in the way he planned and executed our itinerary for the day.  Just a fabulous experience!!
author: Susan H

title: The best day trip to Ronda
text: We just returned from our day trip from Seville to Ronda with Francisco and had the best time. Francisco was a great guide and he let us have full control over what we wanted to do with our day, but also ensured we had time to see the best sights without rushing us. We saw the best views in Ronda and had an amazing lunch at a local tapas place thanks to Francisco’s knowledge of the area! We also visited Sentinel de las Bodegas on the way home which was a beautiful place to see. Would 100% recommend this trip for those who are in Seville and wanting to visit Ronda. title: Unforgettable Trip
text: "My day trip to Ronda and the White Villages with Alberto and Benoit was simply unforgettable. Their deep knowledge and passion for the region brought the stunning landscapes and rich history to life. From the breath-taking views of Ronda to the charming, white-washed villages, every moment was a photographer's dream. Plus, Alberto and Benoit ensured everything was on time and very well-organized. Can't recommend this tour enough!"
author: elenimU1570ZO

title: Ronda and White Villages Excellent Trip
text: We had a great day with Dustin.  Ronda was a fascinating place with great views, architecture and history.  Also the town of Setenil de las Bodegas was interesting with the buildings built under the rocks.
author: C5040CBjoep

title: Great day out
text: A must do tour if you’re in Seville. Ronda is a pretty little town with breathtaking scenery. The enjoyment of the tour was compounded by our guide Miguel. He was knowledgeable about the town itself, the region and Spanish history in general. The white villages were the icing on the cake. Gracias Miguel for a wonderful tour!!
author: Nik_P

title: Family tour in Ronda and Setenil.
text: We had a great time and learned a lot. The tour was perfect for our family which spanned young-teen-middle age. It was more intimate than a large group. Our guide was friendly, knowledgeable, and fun. We highly recommend this group for tours in Andalusia.
author: Kristen B

title: A perfect guide to show the towns wonders
text: Our guide !Miguel! Was professional, he has excellent knowledge and most important he understood our preferences during the long but very productive tour. Ronda and Setenil are two towns that everybody should visit , those towns and the tour visits are amazing natural wonders , our guide Miguel presented to us all the steps of their history.

title: Ronda was superb.
